purpose: Measure the one decision Jev makes inside the agent, choosing 3 of 12 retrieved implementation files, on many more real bugs than the 5-task end-to-end pilot, without running the coding agent.
task_selection: Every instance in the SWE-bench dev split (225 instances, 6 repositories). Instances whose gold patch changes no implementation .py file under the package root are excluded and counted. The SWE-bench test split and SWE-bench Verified are not used; they stay reserved for a later held-out evaluation.
package_root_rule: Use the first listed root that exists at the instance's base commit.
query: The instance's problem_statement (issue text). Difference from the end-to-end pilot: there, Jev sees the parent agent's exploration request instead.
retrieval: Same deterministic BM25-style ranking, tokenizer, 16-line snippet window and 1,800-character snippet cap as coding_probe.py candidates(), generalized from the pydicom/ root to each repository's package root. Verified to reproduce the archived pilot candidates exactly before any new Jev call.

conditions.search: Top 3 retrieval candidates, no model call.
conditions.jev: typesafe/jev-1.14, one decision request per instance with the pilot's exact question wording; top 3 Noul scores, ties broken by retrieval order.
conditions.random: Analytic expectation of choosing 3 of the 12 candidates uniformly at random.

gold_files: Implementation .py files under the package root that the instance's gold patch modifies (paths from 'diff --git' headers, excluding test directories). Gold patches are used only by the scorer, never in retrieval or the Jev request.

metrics.candidate_recall: Share of instances with at least one gold file among the 12 candidates (the ceiling for any selector).
metrics.hit_at_3: Primary. Share of instances with at least one gold file among the 3 selected files.
metrics.all_at_3: Share of instances with every gold file among the 3 selected files.
metrics.conditional_hit_at_3: hit_at_3 restricted to instances whose candidates contain a gold file, so that selection quality is separated from retrieval failures.

analysis: Paired Jev-vs-search comparison on the same instances: wins/losses/ties, exact two-sided sign test on discordant pairs, and a 95% paired bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples of instances, seed 329) for the hit_at_3 difference. Reported overall and per repository. No setting is changed after outcomes are seen.
failure_handling: A Jev API or validation error is recorded and the instance is reported as failed for Jev (not silently replaced by search). Errors are retried at most once.
api_key_source: OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment; the key is never written to disk by this study.
in_situ_analysis: Separately, for the 15 archived pilot runs: gold-file hits among the files each explorer reported to the parent (parsed from the parent's task tool result), and among the files each final patch edited.
